name: Rural Resources and Livelihoods
description: Holistic understanding of concepts, processes and relationships among agro- climatic and natural resources, production systems and livelihoods of rural people. The rural resources include land, soil, water and forests and people's knowledge, synergy between farm and non-farm sectors for generating sustainable livelihoods and poverty alleviation, sustainable wealth generation in rural areas, participatory systems approach.
